verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Supabase Auth's backend capabilities: auth methods, MFA, SSO, sessions, JWTs, hooks and SSR clients. Nothing documents prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted sign-in, sign-up or profile pages. The Next.js and create-t3-turbo starter templates are project scaffolds, which count as developer building blocks rather than the named UI component or hosted-page capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages
